from pathlib import Path
import re

p = Path(
    "apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/"
    "GenesisReplayReadWorkspace.tsx"
)

s = p.read_text()

# The failed Phase 5 already added these. Refuse to guess if it did not.
required = [
    "artifactNavigationTarget",
    "navigateToHistoricalArtifact",
    "GenesisHistoricalArtifactNavigationTarget",
]

for token in required:
    if token not in s:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"ERROR: partial M46 coordinator missing: {token}"
        )

def wire_component(
    text: str,
    component: str,
    prop: str,
) -> str:
    # Already wired => leave intact.
    pattern_existing = re.compile(
        rf"<{component}\b"
        rf"(?:(?!/>).)*?"
        rf"{re.escape(prop)}="
        rf"(?:(?!/>).)*?/>",
        re.S,
    )

    if pattern_existing.search(text):
        print(
            f"{component}: already wired"
        )
        return text

    # Match the actual current component shape regardless of indentation.
    pattern = re.compile(
        rf"(?P<indent>[ \t]*)"
        rf"<{component}\s*\n"
        rf"(?P<body>"
        rf"(?:(?!/>).)*?"
        rf"projection=\{{\s*"
        rf"operational\.projection\s*"
        rf"\}}"
        rf"(?:(?!/>).)*?"
        rf")"
        rf"\s*/>"
        rf"(?:\\\\n)?",
        re.S,
    )

    match = pattern.search(
        text
    )

    if not match:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"ERROR: render block not found for {component}"
        )

    indent = match.group(
        "indent"
    )

    body = match.group(
        "body"
    ).rstrip()

    replacement = (
        f"{indent}<{component}\n"
        f"{body}\n"
        f"{indent}  {prop}={{\n"
        f"{indent}    navigateToHistoricalArtifact\n"
        f"{indent}  }}\n"
        f"{indent}/>"
    )

    print(
        f"{component}: wired"
    )

    return (
        text[:match.start()] +
        replacement +
        text[match.end():]
    )

s = wire_component(
    s,
    "GenesisTemporalChronologyInspector",
    "onNavigateToArtifact",
)

s = wire_component(
    s,
    "GenesisHistoricalRelationshipInspector",
    "onNavigateToArtifact",
)

s = wire_component(
    s,
    "GenesisEvolutionEpisodeInspector",
    "onNavigateToArtifact",
)

# Historical Artifact Explorer receives the shared destination target,
# not the callback.
if not re.search(
    r"<GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer\b"
    r"(?:(?!/>).)*?"
    r"navigationTarget=",
    s,
    re.S,
):
    pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?P<indent>[ \t]*)"
        r"<GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer\s*\n"
        r"(?P<body>"
        r"(?:(?!/>).)*?"
        r"projection=\{\s*"
        r"operational\.projection\s*"
        r"\}"
        r"(?:(?!/>).)*?"
        r")"
        r"\s*/>"
        r"(?:\\\\n)?",
        re.S,
    )

    match = pattern.search(
        s
    )

    if not match:
        raise SystemExit(
            "ERROR: Historical Artifact Explorer render block not found"
        )

    indent = match.group(
        "indent"
    )

    body = match.group(
        "body"
    ).rstrip()

    replacement = (
        f"{indent}<GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer\n"
        f"{body}\n"
        f"{indent}  navigationTarget={{\n"
        f"{indent}    artifactNavigationTarget\n"
        f"{indent}  }}\n"
        f"{indent}/>"
    )

    s = (
        s[:match.start()] +
        replacement +
        s[match.end():]
    )

    print(
        "GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer: navigation target wired"
    )
else:
    print(
        "GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer: already wired"
    )

# Remove residual literal backslash-n JSX text left by the older
# section-wrapper patch. These are not real line endings.
s = re.sub(
    r"(/>)\\\\n(?=\s*</section>)",
    r"\1",
    s,
)

p.write_text(
    s
)

print(
    "M46 workspace coordinator completed against actual Genesis composition."
)

Bashset -euo pipefail

cd /Users/erictouko/dev/korelumina

WORKSPACE="apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/GenesisReplayReadWorkspace.tsx"

echo "===== M46 — COMPLETE WORKSPACE CROSS-NAVIGATION COORDINATOR ====="

python3 <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

p = Path(
    "apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/"
    "GenesisReplayReadWorkspace.tsx"
)

s = p.read_text()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. React coordinator hooks
# ---------------------------------------------------------

if not re.search(
    r'import\s*\{[^}]*useCallback[^}]*useState[^}]*\}\s*from\s*"react";',
    s,
    re.S,
):
    if s.startswith('import {\n'):
        # No React import currently exists in this workspace.
        s = '''import {
  useCallback,
  useState,
} from "react";

''' + s
    else:
        raise SystemExit(
            "ERROR: unexpected Genesis workspace import preamble"
        )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Navigation type import
# ---------------------------------------------------------

relationship_import = '''import {
  GenesisHistoricalRelationshipInspector,
} from "./GenesisHistoricalRelationshipInspector";
'''

navigation_import = relationship_import + '''
import type {
  GenesisHistoricalArtifactNavigationTarget,
} from "./GenesisHistoricalNavigation";
'''

if "GenesisHistoricalArtifactNavigationTarget" not in s:
    if relationship_import not in s:
        raise SystemExit(
            "ERROR: Historical Relationship import anchor missing"
        )

    s = s.replace(
        relationship_import,
        navigation_import,
        1,
    )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Shared navigation state + coordinator
# ---------------------------------------------------------

snapshot_anchor = '''  const {
    replay,
    operational,
  } =
    snapshot;
'''

coordinator = snapshot_anchor + '''

  const [
    artifactNavigationTarget,
    setArtifactNavigationTarget,
  ] =
    useState<
      GenesisHistoricalArtifactNavigationTarget |
      null
    >(
      null,
    );

  const navigateToHistoricalArtifact =
    useCallback(
      (
        target:
          Omit<
            GenesisHistoricalArtifactNavigationTarget,
            "requestId"
          >,
      ) => {
        setArtifactNavigationTarget(
          previous => ({
            ...target,

            requestId:
              (previous?.requestId ?? 0) +
              1,
          }),
        );

        requestAnimationFrame(
          () => {
            const targetElement =
              document.getElementById(
                "genesis-historical-artifacts",
              );

            if (
              !targetElement
            ) {
              return;
            }

            const reduceMotion =
              window.matchMedia(
                "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)",
              ).matches;

            targetElement.scrollIntoView({
              behavior:
                reduceMotion
                  ? "auto"
                  : "smooth",

              block:
                "start",
            });
          },
        );
      },
      [],
    );
'''

if "const navigateToHistoricalArtifact" not in s:
    if snapshot_anchor not in s:
        raise SystemExit(
            "ERROR: workspace snapshot anchor missing"
        )

    s = s.replace(
        snapshot_anchor,
        coordinator,
        1,
    )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Robust component-prop injector
# ---------------------------------------------------------

def inject_prop(
    source: str,
    component: str,
    prop_block: str,
    prop_name: str,
) -> str:
    pattern = re.compile(
        rf'(?P<indent>^[ \t]*)'
        rf'<{component}\b'
        rf'(?P<body>.*?)'
        rf'(?P<close>^[ \t]*/>)'
        rf'(?P<junk>\\n)?',
        re.M | re.S,
    )

    match = pattern.search(
        source
    )

    if not match:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"ERROR: {component} render block not found"
        )

    full = match.group(0)

    if prop_name in full:
        # Also clean historical literal \n residue if present.
        return (
            source[:match.start()] +
            full.replace(
                "\\n",
                "",
            ) +
            source[match.end():]
        )

    close = match.group(
        "close"
    )

    indentation = re.match(
        r'^[ \t]*',
        close,
    ).group(0)

    replacement_close = (
        prop_block.format(
            indent=indentation,
        ) +
        close
    )

    updated = (
        full.replace(
            close,
            replacement_close,
            1,
        )
        .replace(
            "\\n",
            "",
        )
    )

    return (
        source[:match.start()] +
        updated +
        source[match.end():]
    )

callback_prop = '''{indent}onNavigateToArtifact={{
{indent}  navigateToHistoricalArtifact
{indent}}}
'''

s = inject_prop(
    s,
    "GenesisTemporalChronologyInspector",
    callback_prop,
    "onNavigateToArtifact",
)

s = inject_prop(
    s,
    "GenesisHistoricalRelationshipInspector",
    callback_prop,
    "onNavigateToArtifact",
)

s = inject_prop(
    s,
    "GenesisEvolutionEpisodeInspector",
    callback_prop,
    "onNavigateToArtifact",
)

target_prop = '''{indent}navigationTarget={{
{indent}  artifactNavigationTarget
{indent}}}
'''

s = inject_prop(
    s,
    "GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer",
    target_prop,
    "navigationTarget",
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Clean known malformed JSX residue globally.
#
# Only remove literal backslash-n immediately after a
# self-closing JSX tag. Do not touch real string escapes.
# ---------------------------------------------------------

s = re.sub(
    r'(/>)\\n(?=\s*</section>)',
    r'\1',
    s,
)

p.write_text(
    s
)

print(
    "Genesis workspace cross-navigation coordinator installed."
)
